requirement_structuring.structuring_summary: Requirement is unambiguous and atomic. Structured as a single constraint requirement based on the defined vehicle class.

source_fragments: All medium-sized vehicles shall be equipped with a navigation system.

fields.condition: The vehicle is a medium-sized vehicle

structured_requirements.final_statement: All medium-sized vehicles shall be equipped with a navigation system.
structuring_notes: This requirement mandates an equipment feature for a specific class of vehicle, classifying it as a design constraint rather than a system behavior.

unsupported_inferences_avoided: Did not specify the type or standard of the navigation system, as this detail was not provided in the requirement or context.
